index.badge: AI-POWERED VIBE CODING TEMPLATE // ARCHITECTURE READY
index.hero_desc: is a professional starter template for building web apps via vibe coding: specify requirements in docs, let AI coding assistant forge the entire functional codebase.
index.why_subtitle: Clean architecture designed specifically for AI CLI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to work seamlessly.
index.feat_doc_desc: Simply update docs/prd.md & docs/branding.md. AI executes features precisely.
index.feat_shell_desc: Landing page, login, register, management, admin, client — isolated via thin Shells with AJAX router proxy.
index.feat_security_desc: Argon2ID password hashing, automated CSRF protection, IP/Username rate-limiting, and RBAC middleware.
index.feat_i18n_desc: Centralized multi-language translation with GeoIP detection and full RTL layout support (Arabic).
index.setup_subtitle: Run the following PowerShell command to clone the template and configure a workspace on your local server.
index.skrip_step1: Download the latest version of Vibeforge template
index.skrip_step2: Setup SPA shell folder structure (manajemen/, admin/, client/)
index.skrip_step3: Configure Virtual Host & Local Host DNS domain (.test)
index.skrip_step4: Initialize users.json with Argon2ID encrypted demo credentials
index.unified_desc: After running the command above, the wizard opens at http://<app-name>.test/install/ with 4 unified steps — no separate Greenfield/Redesign option. Frontend, role, and storage are automatically derived from the generated PRD.
index.step1_desc: Auto-detected status: app name, folder path, local domain (.test), & PHP version. No manual input — Start button only.
index.step2_desc: Upload HTML/CSS/JS or legacy source code to references/. Skip if starting from scratch — structure is derived from PRD in Step 4.
index.step3_desc: Brand identity automatically follows the final PRD — simply upload a logo. Or complete the full manual form (name, tagline, color palette, typography).
index.step4_desc: Auto-generate PRD via AI with a 7-section structure (Problem, Goals, Users, Stories, FR, NFR, Scope), or paste your own PRD. Then click Run for AI execution.
index.demo_subtitle: One-click test for role-based access control (RBAC) authentication & authorization without typing credentials.
index.role_super_admin_desc: Full access to system overview, audit trail, finances & creator approvals.
index.role_creator_desc: Content upload dashboard, performance analytics, & royalty management.
index.role_client_desc: User/listener interface for exploration, playlists, & audio player.
index.cta_desc: This project is 100% open-source under Apache 2.0 license. Free for commercial and personal apps.
index.pillars_subtitle: Vibeforge maps 13 Software Pillars into PHP native architecture.
index.checklist_sub: Ensure all requirements are met before deploying to live server.
